palette: blue-grey granite, ink-stone charcoal, rice-paper cream, cinnabar rub red, brass inlay gold, moss green, slate indigo
typography: WenKai headings on brass-inlaid pillar plaques, chiselled condition lines and cinnabar rub verdicts
composition: a granite hall aisle flanked by principle pillars; forks, twin benches and bounded courts occupy the aisle
surface: dressed granite blocks, rice-paper plaques, brass inlay strips, chipped violation cracks
motion: principle plaques seat onto their pillars, verdict seals press down, fork tokens travel the branching paths and settle as terminal states
transition: the hall floor, aisle lighting and pillar flanks persist while the aisle furnishing is exchanged between scenes
